reports.title: •Fiscal 2026 GAAP diluted net earnings per share ("EPS") of $2.62, inclusive of tariff refunds, and down 1.1% from the prior year period

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For fiscal 2027, HP estimates free cash flow to be in the range of $2.9 to $3.1 billion.
More information on HP's earnings, including additional financial analysis and an earnings overview presentation, is available on HP's Investor Relations website at https://investor.hp.com.
HP's FY26 Q4 earnings conference call is accessible via audio webcast at www.hp.com/investor/2026Q4Webcast.

desk.headline: Revenue up 9.3% to $16.0bn and adjusted EPS of $0.83, both above estimates; FY27 outlook initiated on a new basis
results: Revenue rose 9.3% to $16.0bn, above the $15.3bn estimate; adjusted EPS of $0.83 beat the $0.74 estimate but fell from $0.93.
Tariff refunds added $0.15 to Q4 EPS; adjusted operating margin fell to 6.2% from 8.0%.
PC revenue rose 14% on business demand (+23%) even though units fell 29%; the PC margin dropped to 3.0%.
Printing revenue slipped 1% to $4.3bn, with its margin up to 19.7%.
Full year: revenue $60.5bn (+9.5%), adjusted EPS $3.33, free cash flow $3.3bn and $2.3bn returned to shareholders; dividend raised to $0.31.

guidance.summary: First outlook for FY27: adjusted EPS of $3.15–3.45 and free cash flow of $2.9–3.1bn, with Q1 EPS of $0.66–0.76. From FY27, adjusted figures exclude stock-based pay (worth $0.38 in FY26), so they do not compare directly with FY26.

points: Memory and storage now make up about 40% of a PC's parts cost, and management expects those costs to keep rising, more slowly.
Management expects PC units to fall high single digits to low double digits in 2027, with revenue roughly flat.
PCs with built-in artificial-intelligence chips were nearly 60% of Q4 shipments, ahead of the 50% target.
The PC margin should return to the 5–7% range before the end of FY27; Q1 is expected to be seasonally weak.
Management called the outlook prudent, targets about $1bn of yearly savings by FY28, and the incoming CEO starts in January.

watch: Memory and storage costs and whether price rises protect the PC margin.
PC unit demand in 2027 against the expected decline.
Strategy changes under the incoming CEO.
